Team —

Attached is a draft mutual action plan (Stellaris_MAP_v1.xlsx) that stitches together evaluation milestones, evidence handoffs, and signature order for MSA, DPA and order form. High-level constraints from Stellaris: they require SOC2 evidence by the time of DPA engagement (they flagged legal as sensitive), and procurement wants the order form to be tied to committed usage lanes.

Key asks from me:
- Can Legal/Procurement accept a phased sign approach where we execute an MSA first, then DPA redlines + evidence, then order form?
- If yes, what minimal evidence package (SOC2 + SIEM logs + retention agreement) should be requested to unblock a canary pilot?
- Any objections to sequencing the commercial signature (order form) after a 30-day pilot with capped usage?

I've put proposed dates in the sheet for an aggressive 4-week evaluation (pilot kickoff 2025-07-07). Please review and flag legal hooks or clauses we should pre-clear (data residency, EEA export controls, trial data retention).

Attachments: Stellaris_MAP_v1.xlsx

David —

Thanks for the draft MAP. Quick context from our side:
- Legal will only start reviewing DPA redlines after we have a baseline MSA (they want the security obligations scoped against a signed contract).
- Procurement needs commercial terms (order form) linked to a committed seat/throughput band for pricing; they prefer order form sign-off concurrent with the DPA, but we can be flexible for a pilot if Legal approves the evidence gating.

Two questions to unblock scheduling:
1) What exact SOC2 artifacts are you able to provide within two weeks (report vs. attestation letter vs. vendor access)?
2) Can you support a 30-day pilot with telemetry export to our test tenant and a limited token cap? We need an ops contact to set up the test environment.

I attached procurement guidance and a simple redline summary from our side (referenced as inline notes below).

Thanks — looping Procurement (procurement@stellarishealth.com) for timeline input.

—Emily Stone
Director, Strategic Procurement
Stellaris Health

Emily / team —

Appreciate the clarity. Short answers up front:
- SOC2: we can provide an SSAE SOC2 Type II report (redacted) within 5 business days and a security attestation letter the same day. For additional evidence (SIEM logs), we can provide a scoped export for the pilot environment with an NDA.
- Pilot: we can support a 30-day pilot with a token cap and a telemetry export to your test tenant. Ops contact: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com) — she will own environment setup and onboarding.

Sequencing (recommended):
1) Sign MSA (covers commercial relationship, liability caps, basic security obligations) — target: DocuSign send 2025-07-02.
2) Run 30-day pilot (limited telemetry, evidence exports) — pilot kickoff: 2025-07-07.
3) Legal to start DPA redline review in parallel on receipt of MSA; we provide SOC2 artifacts by 2025-07-09.
4) Order form (pricing bands) to be executed at pilot completion if success metrics met — target sign 2025-08-08.

Notes on gating items for Legal: data retention windows for pilot artifacts, access controls for telemetry exports, and indemnity carve-outs for third-party model components. I'll draft minimal clause language for the DPA to speed review (will attach by EOD tomorrow).

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
